messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a 30m runthrough for the SI demo next Tue. Goal: validate LangChain adapter + LlamaIndex pipeline hitting Redwood gateway + orchestration. Focus: auth/manifest, streaming, reconnects, and marketplace packaging. Who can lead the validation steps?
kevin: I can lead the adapter tests. Can someone own the orchestration (rollout/canary) piece?
aj: I can take orchestration. I'll test canary -> fallback paths and autoscale hooks.
sophia: I'll handle the LlamaIndex indexing + sample dataset. Need to confirm embedding model variant and token limits.
maria: Thanks. Key acceptance criteria: 1) adapter authenticates via API key & header manifest; 2) streaming works end-to-end with < 200ms first-token for 2/3 runs; 3) canary rollback triggers on regression; 4) marketplace asset packages and docs uploaded.
kevin: For auth, we're testing two flows: header API key and token exchange via our gateway. Quick sample manifest I used:
```yaml
adapter: langchain
version: 0.3.1
auth:
  type: api_key
  header: X-Redwood-Key
endpoints:
  - /generate
  - /embed
```
kevin: I'll run both flows against dedicated sandbox.
marketplace-bot: Asset upload succeeded: https://marketplace.redwood.local/assets/si-demo-adapter-0.3.1 (sha256: b4f3...).
sophia: @kevin for embeddings we should pin to the quantized variant (q4f32) — lower cost and acceptable quality for the demo. I'll prepare a small validation set (~200 queries).
aj: Orch checklist: canary window = 5m, rollback on avg latency + quality delta > 8%. I will add a runbook step to force fallback to hosted-lower-tier model when GPU pool saturates.
eli: Reconnects note — we saw TTL for KV cache dropping on reconnect in last run. Patch on runtime fixes reconnection but requires model shard affinity enabled. We should toggle shard_affinity=true in the orchestration job for the demo.
maria: Good catch. aj, can you add that to the canary config?
aj: Yep — adding shard_affinity=true and a healthcheck probe every 15s. Also will script a simulated overload to verify graceful degradation.
kevin: One more: telemetry events needed for the SI — token-cost per request and per-route latency. Can we wire a temporary dashboard? @marketplace-bot can you export a short dashboard url?
marketplace-bot: Dashboard created: https://console.redwood.local/d/si-demo/runthrough-2265 (retention 7d).
sophia: I'll upload the sample dataset and the LlamaIndex connector config tonight. After that kevin can run adapter validation in the morning.
maria: Proposed run schedule: Mon 10am PT dry run (internal), Tue 9am PT final run with SI. Everyone OK? :thumbsup:
kevin: +1
aj: +1
sophia: +1
eli: +1
maria: Thanks all — I'll post the runbook and meeting invite. If anything blocks, DM me.
